speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Intussusception

I see the abdominal distension and discomfort you described; given the classic presentation of an 8-month-old with feeding difficulties and a swollen abdomen, this is highly suggestive of intussusception. We need to confirm this urgently with an ultrasound, as the condition can be life-threatening if not treated promptly. Please have the ultrasound prepared immediately.
